facts.fact: DHIS2 states that Edo State has future plans to implement the SEMIS system for individual-level tracking of students, staff and schools, the system in use (EdoEMIS) taking school-level data; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

systems.platform: DHIS2, with the DHIS2 Capture mobile app or web interface
systems.owner: Edo State Ministry of Education under its EdoDiDA initiative, implemented and supported by Data Science Nigeria with support from the Gates Foundation
systems.tiers: implemented 2023; 51 pilot schools, urban and rural, with over 17,000 students and more than 350 teachers; school staff submit school-level attendance, punctuality and resource-need data daily; said to be being scaled to schools across the state
future plan: individual-level tracking of students, staff and schools

note: For the parent: EdoEMIS is described as daily submission of school-level data on attendance, punctuality and resource needs, with individual-level tracking named as a future plan under SEMIS, so the document does not say schools add per-learner records and EdoEMIS gives no fact. If it is ruled emis, the document supports: kept routine (daily entry at the school); schools pilot (51 pilot schools, no total; scaling statewide); levels not stated; owner Edo State Ministry of Education; finance Gates Foundation support; implemented 2023.
